findings.evidence: candidate.diff lines 11509-11575 (request_repair), 11584-11627 (require_full_check_evidence and the required-checks gate), 11682-11819 (advance_final_publication with main-only carry and CI wait); proposal.md Impact lists only `template/scripts/{requirement_composition,openspec_lifecycle}.py`, tests and manifest.
findings.summary: The candidate diff changes much more than this change's declared scope. The proposal's Impact section lists only requirement_composition.py, openspec_lifecycle.py, tests and the manifest, and the delta spec adds a single requirement. The diff also adds composition repair requests, required-CI gating and main-only full-check carry chains in requirement_composition.py. It touches publication_queue.py, integration_contour.py, execute_requirement.py and others, and adds receipt-drift checks in validate_children. None of these appear in this change's proposal, design, tasks or delta spec. They look like they belong to other changes (e.g. BR-949 T2 contribution binding) merged into this branch. The finalize-through-shared-function requirement itself is implemented as specified.
